name: berth-plugin-docker
description: Creates a long-running Ubuntu container with systemd and SSH, to be set up like any other machine.

provisioners.label: Docker container
provisioners.description: An Ubuntu 26.04 container with systemd and an SSH server, on the local Docker or on the engine named by host. berth applies its role to it over SSH.

arguments.name: host
arguments.label: Docker endpoint
arguments.help: The Docker engine to use, such as ssh://ops@192.0.2.10. Empty uses the local default.

arguments.name: image
arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image to start from. Empty builds the one that comes with the plugin.

arguments.name: runtime
arguments.label: Runtime
arguments.help: privileged runs the container with --privileged, so root in it is root on the Docker host. sysbox runs it with the Sysbox runtime instead, which needs Sysbox on the Docker host.

arguments.name: ssh_port
arguments.label: SSH port
arguments.help: A port of the Docker host to publish the container's SSH on, such as 2222. Empty publishes none.

arguments.name: publish_address
arguments.label: Publish address
arguments.help: The address berth reaches the published SSH port at. A loopback address such as 127.0.0.1 keeps the port on the Docker host's loopback; any other publishes it on every address of the Docker host.

arguments.name: volume
arguments.label: Volume
arguments.help: The volume for /srv/agent, the agent's work. Empty uses berth-HOST-data.

arguments.name: cpus
arguments.label: CPUs
arguments.help: How many CPUs the container may use, such as 4. Empty sets no limit.

arguments.name: memory
arguments.label: Memory
arguments.help: How much memory the container may use, such as 8g. Empty sets no limit.

arguments.name: keep_volume
arguments.label: Keep volume on destroy
arguments.help: Whether deleting the machine keeps its volume, so a new machine can take the agent's work over.

actions.name: engine
actions.label: Check the engine
actions.help: Ask the Docker engine for its version, its runtimes and how many containers berth made there.

actions.name: images
actions.label: Images
actions.help: The images the engine has, with their sizes.

actions.name: volumes
actions.label: Volumes berth made
actions.help: The volumes berth made for its machines, and whether a container uses each. One kept with keep_volume stays here until it is removed.

actions.name: build
actions.label: Build the image
actions.help: Build the image the plugin brings, which a new machine starts from unless it names another. Creating the first machine builds it too; this does it ahead of time.

actions.name: prune
actions.label: Remove what berth left behind
actions.confirm: Remove the images of older versions of this plugin that no container uses, and with volumes=yes the volumes berth made that no container uses?
actions.help: Remove the images of older versions of this plugin that no container uses. With volumes=yes also the volumes berth made that no container uses, such as those kept with keep_volume, and the agent's work in them. Nothing berth did not make is touched, and no container is.

arguments.name: volumes
arguments.label: Also volumes
arguments.help: yes also removes the volumes berth made that no container uses, with what is in them.
